messages:
maria_cs: Rapid notes from PulseHaven onboarding (11:04 PT). Finance alarmed by an embedding spend spike during pilot. Dropping raw asks so Product/ENG can triage.

maria_cs: Main asks: per-route spend export (CSV) + route trend chart in Console; configurable embedding TTL per-route/project; model pinning per-route with explicit soft-fallback option; clearer 429 diagnostics + recommended remediation; a compact "first-7-days" onboarding dashboard (usage, latency, cost) for CFO review.

maria_cs: Customer said: 
> "We need exportable proof for finance. The spike made us pause the pilot."

noah_product: Thanks. Can CS paste the route name + spike time for a trace? Also clarify TTL: server-side eviction vs client-side stale flag?

maria_cs: Route: pulse-search-v1; spike time: 2026-03-14T02:40:12Z. They want server-side TTL control (24h/7d options).

alex_se: I'll pull metrics for that window and attach a Grafana snapshot. Short-term workaround: tag route and use billing export grouped by tag so they can show spend by route.

alex_se: Note: backend rollout supports pinning but Console lacks a simple UI toggle. Low-effort experiment: add a "pin route" toggle that applies rollout weight=100.

noah_product: Proposal: split into lanes: 1) Cost visibility (per-route CSV + trend + onboarding dashboard) = P0 for renewal risk. 2) Operational controls (TTL, pin UI, 429 UX) = P1/backlog. Agree @taylor_pm?

taylor_pm: Agree. Metering + CSV = P0 (ETA 2w); onboarding dashboard = ETA 3w. Operational controls -> investigate then schedule.

sam_bot: Created tickets INF-5011 (per-route CSV) and INF-5012 (onboarding 7-day dashboard).

alex_se: I'll attach reproducer logs and metrics to INF-5011 EOD. ENG check: KV cache churn + overlapping batch jobs may drive duplicate embedding calls.

maria_cs: I'll request permission to share their billing sample and paste examples tomorrow. Will offer tagging workaround now.

noah_product: CS please provide 2-3 prioritized CSV schemas/use-cases so we can finalize export fields (suggested: timestamp, route, model, tokens_in, tokens_out, embedding_calls, est_cost_usd, request_id).

maria_cs: Will DM finance and paste samples tomorrow AM.

taylor_pm: Owners: per-route CSV owner=noah_product ETA=2w; onboarding dashboard owner=taylor_pm ETA=3w; emb TTL investigation owner=alex_se ETA=investigation.

maria_cs: Action: communicate tickets + ETAs to PulseHaven and loop in finance contact. Owner=maria_cs, due=tomorrow EOD.

noah_product: Thanks team. Keep short updates here; we'll convert to PRD if scope increases.

sam_bot: Thread will be archived after 90 days per retention policy.
